p.d: Bernie urges the new maid (guest star Theresa Saldana) to treat the children as if they were her own.

p.d: Bernie's sister wants to help raise her niece and nephew but squabbles with her brother over parenting methods.

p.t: The Bernie Mac Show - For a Few Dollars More
p.d: Bernie bribes kids to attend Jordan's birthday bash instead of another kid's party that is slated for the same day.

p.t: The Bernie Mac Show - Eye of the Tiger
p.d: Jordan tries out for the basketball team, but the coach decides he is better suited for gymnastics as a ribbon dancer.
